idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.9.2

  • Build fix: 'return@try' isn't valid Kotlin (try blocks aren't labeled scopes). Restructured tryExtractContent to wrap the body in try/catch with regular function-level returns.

0.9.1

  • Build fix: 0.9.0 didn't compile (protected Clipboard.contents access + a chained ?.let { return@try ... } that the Kotlin parser couldn't make sense of). Same feature set, now actually buildable.

0.9.0

  • Attach arbitrary files to a message: via the hamburger menu's Attach files... entry, by drag-dropping onto the input box, or by Ctrl+V from the system clipboard.
  • Pending file attachments now appear alongside image thumbnails above the input, each with a small X to remove it before sending.
  • Ctrl+V is now bound directly on the input area. Image paste reliably reaches the plugin's handler, instead of being swallowed by Rider's IDE-level paste action.
  • Binary non-image files are rejected with a chat warning instead of silently sending garbage to the model.

0.8.1

  • Middle-click tab close now handles modern JBTabs - the tab label's getInfo()->TabInfo->getObject() path (used by Rider 2024.x+/2025.x) in addition to the older ContentTabLabel.getContent().

0.8.0

  • Agent mode is now ON by default in new chats. Claude can read, edit, and create files in the project right away. Every write still requires your approval with diff preview (toggle agent mode off in the hamburger menu for plain streaming chat).

0.7.5

  • Middle-click tab close now duck-types on the tab label's getContent() method rather than matching ContentTabLabel by name, so it works on Rider builds where the tab label class is named differently. (You can also close a chat via the hamburger -> "Close this chat" at any time.)

0.7.4

  • Image paste now also accepts file-list clipboard contents (e.g. images copied from Explorer) and image files dropped onto the chat input. Previously only the AWT imageFlavor path worked, which many Windows screenshots / file-copy operations don't use.

0.7.3

  • Fix NPE in AccentToggleButton.getForeground during initialization that prevented the tool window factory from constructing the chat panel, which is why everyone since 0.5.x was seeing "Nothing to show". The bug was a Kotlin non-null return type on an overridden Swing method that the L&F's installColors calls before subclass fields are set.

0.7.2
